CommunityApplications.Profile:
Bunkarr is a self-hosted, arr-style backup app for Plex media libraries and the arr stack. It gives irreplaceable data (the Plex database, the Sonarr, Radarr and Lidarr configuration, personal media) full, versioned backups; content that is easy to download again can instead get a manifest-only backup (its IDs, quality profile and root folder). Beta, pre-1.0: the restore wizard is not built yet, so restores and re-acquiring manifest-only content are manual.
It is built around not losing data: sources are mounted read-only and never changed, replaced and deleted files are kept in retention, an unmounted share or source stops the sync, unusually large deletes wait for you to confirm, and off-site copies come with a recovery kit that restores without Bunkarr. Back up bunkarr.key together with Bunkarr's database: without the key the stored credentials cannot be decrypted.
This repository holds the Bunkarr source code and its Unraid template. Image: ghcr.io/sl0wz3r/bunkarr:latest
